title: AI Translation Settings
subtitle: Configure the LLM provider that turns plain-language rules into Bluestar PLM condition and formula syntax.
activeProviderHint: The enabled provider used for all translations.

providers.title: Providers
providers.modelHint: Use the provider's API model ID (lowercase, hyphenated) — e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet-latest, gemini-2.0-flash. Not a display name.
providers.testHint: Save first — the test uses the stored key.

grounding.title: Syntax grounding
grounding.description: The Bluestar PLM reference guide is sent to the model as grounding for every translation.

instructions.title: Agent instructions
instructions.description: Behaviour guidance layered on top of the reference guide, one set per editing context.

translate.title: AI translate
translate.prompt: Describe the rule in plain language
translate.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Include this line only when the frame width is greater than 1200 mm

bulk.title: AI translate conditions & formulas
bulk.description: Queues every selected plain-language condition and formula for translation into Bluestar PLM syntax. The run continues in the background — you can close the page and review the suggestions later.
bulk.onlyEmpty: Only cells with no PLM value yet
bulk.nothingToTranslate: No plain-language conditions or formulas to translate.
bulk.noneSelected: Select at least one cell to translate.
bulk.started: Translation started. You can keep working.
bulk.startFailed: Could not start the translation run.

job.title: AI translation run
job.none: No translation run yet for this document.
job.queuedAhead: Queued — {{n}} run(s) ahead of this one.
